verses.ar: الٓرٰࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ وَقُرۡاٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear

verses.ar: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡ كَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam

verses.ar: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَاۡكُلُوۡا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوۡا وَيُلۡهِهِمُ الۡاَمَلُ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them)

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ
verses.en: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand

verses.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡ نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌؕ‏
verses.en: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)

verses.ar: لَوۡمَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا بِالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth

verses.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوۡ٘ا اِذًا مُّنۡظَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِيۡ شِيَعِ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old

verses.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهٗ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners

verses.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوۡا فِيۡهِ يَعۡرُجُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein

verses.ar: لَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ اَبۡصَارُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٌ مَّسۡحُوۡرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّزَيَّنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders

verses.ar: وَحَفِظۡنٰهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡطٰنٍ رَّجِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ اسۡتَرَقَ السَّمۡعَ فَاَتۡبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see)

verses.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰهَا وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مَّوۡزُوۡنٍ
verses.en: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنۡ لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا عِنۡدَنَا خَزَآئِنُهٗؗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗ٘ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ
verses.en: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures

verses.ar: وَاَرۡسَلۡنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمُوۡهُۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيٖ وَنُمِيۡتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَ
verses.en: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَاۡخِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيۡمٌ عَلِيۡمٌࣖ‏
verses.en: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape

verses.ar: وَالۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ مِنۡ نَّارِ السَّمُوۡمِ
verses.en: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّيۡ خَالِقٌۭ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.en: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape

verses.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِيۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves

verses.ar: قَالَ لَمۡ اَكُنۡ لِّاَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.en: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ اللَّعۡنَةَ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ
verses.en: And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee

verses.ar: اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ
verses.en: Till the Day of the Time appointed

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا٘ اَغۡوَيۡتَنِيۡ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَاُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong

verses.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
verses.en: Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me

verses.ar: اِنَّ عِبَادِيۡ لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِيۡنَ
verses.en: For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all

verses.ar: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ اَبۡوَابٍؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٌ مَّقۡسُوۡمٌࣖ‏
verses.en: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍؕ‏
verses.en: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water)

verses.ar: اُدۡخُلُوۡهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security

verses.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ اِخۡوَانًا عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity)

verses.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
verses.en: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave

verses.ar: نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيۡ٘ اَنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِيۡ هُوَ الۡعَذَابُ الۡاَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَۘ‏
verses.en: Tell them about the guests of Abraham

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنۡكُمۡ وَجِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا تَوۡجَلۡ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom

verses.ar: قَالَ اَبَشَّرۡتُمُوۡنِيۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ مَّسَّنِيَ الۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَشَّرۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡقٰنِطِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡنَطُ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهٖ٘ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All

verses.ar: اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرۡنَا٘ۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اٰلَ لُوۡطِ اِۨلۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt

verses.ar: وَاَتَيۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth

verses.ar: فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَاتَّبِعۡ اَدۡبَارَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ وَّامۡضُوۡا حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered

verses.ar: وَقَضَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ ذٰلِكَ الۡاَمۡرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوۡعٌ مُّصۡبِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ اَهۡلُ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men)

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِيۡ فَلَا تَفۡضَحُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not

verses.ar: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ
verses.en: But fear Allah, and shame me not

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيۡ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)

verses.ar: لَعَمۡرُكَ اِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
verses.en: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning

verses.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍؕ‏
verses.en: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيۡلٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: And the (cities were) right on the high-road

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَيۡكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers

verses.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕࣖ‏
verses.en: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡحِجۡرِ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers

verses.ar: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them

verses.ar: وَكَانُوۡا يَنۡحِتُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning

verses.ar: فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصۡفَحِ الصَّفۡحَ الۡجَمِيۡلَ
verses.en: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ سَبۡعًا مِّنَ الۡمَثَانِيۡ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنَ الۡعَظِيۡمَ
verses.en: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an

verses.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا النَّذِيۡرُ الۡمُبِيۡنُۚ‏
verses.en: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity

verses.ar: كَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَي الۡمُقۡتَسِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts)

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ جَعَلُوا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ عِضِيۡنَ
verses.en: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please)

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account

verses.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣔ‏
verses.en: For all their deeds

verses.ar: فَاصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah

verses.ar: اِنَّا كَفَيۡنٰكَ الۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration

verses.ar: وَاعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰي يَاۡتِيَكَ الۡيَقِيۡنُࣖ‏
verses.en: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain
